title: Microsoft Viva: Insights and Copilot Analytics expand in GCC and GCC High
summary: The briefing passes with minor corrections to the two feature-access paths and the dashboard licensing explanation. Microsoft's updated PowerShell policy page still says these controls are unavailable in GCC High; the briefing already reports that limitation.
